info.title: API.SH: Practo
info.description: The Practo API from API.SH: public Practo data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Health articles written by doctors on Practo's health feed, 10 a page: id, title, link, summary, published and modified times, views, likes, shares, comments, rating, word count, reading time, image, tags, health interests and the author (name, photo). Search with `q`, or pass `id` for one article with its full content. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/practo-articles

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words, e.g. diabetes (leave out for the latest feed).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One article: its id or practo.com/healthfeed/<title>-<id>/post link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One clinic or hospital on Practo: id, name, link, type, image, summary, tagline, website, year established, open 24x7, beds, ambulances, emergency phone, address, landmark, locality, city, state, country, postcode, coordinates, opening hours, rating, recommendations, appointment experience score, amenities, wheelchair access, insurance providers, corporate tie-ups, accreditations, awards, specialties, procedures with price ranges, treatments (with total count and treatment specialties), doctor count, doctor specialties with counts, links to every listed doctor, the first doctors (name, link, photo, experience, specialties, qualifications, services, patient stories, fees, prepaid amount, timings, wait time, next available slot), branches by city, photos and media, an about text, FAQ, patient story count, the first patient stories (author, recommends, text, date, reply, visited for, tags) and review topics.

get.description:
Professional listing data only. Filter by gender, years of experience, consultation fee, patient stories, availability (next 4 hours, today, tomorrow, next 7 days), video consultation and hospital chain; a filtered search also returns `total`, `applied_filters`, `filter_options` (each filter with its values), the clinic address, and each doctor's next available time and first open slots. 10 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/practo-search

parameters.name: locality
parameters.description: Locality slug within the city, e.g. `koramangala`, `indiranagar`.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Doctor's gender: male, female (or both, comma-separated).

parameters.name: min_fee
parameters.description: Minimum consultation fee (in the city's currency, e.g. rupees).

parameters.name: availability
parameters.description: Only doctors with an open appointment slot in this window.

parameters.name: video_consult
parameters.description: true: only doctors who offer video consultations.

parameters.name: hospital_group
parameters.description: Hospital or clinic chain id(s) from `filter_options` (key `top_group_ids`), comma-separated.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The doctor specialities Practo lists as popular in a city (slug for /practo/v1/search, name and link), nearby suggestions, and the doctor-search filters with their values (gender, patient stories, experience, fees, availability...).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/practo-specialities

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
